name: CSN 6682 试音 襟翼卡起飞位 液压漏油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 682, you are at stand K38 with information B, your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 682，在 K38 号停机位，通播 B，目的地广州，向武汉放行请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 6682，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 682, I read you 3, loud background whistle, check your transmitter.
B: You have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 682，我听你 3，背景有很大的哨音，检查你的发射机。
B：你检查发射机后，在 118.3 频率与武汉放行进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Delivery, CSN 6682, radio check on frequency 118.3,
1，2，3，4，5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉放行，CSN 6682，在频率 118.3 无线电检查，
1，2，3，4，5，你听我怎样？

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 682, I read you 5.
B: Acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 682，我听你 5。
B：确认收到并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，跑道 36R，可以起飞，地面风 350 度，5 节。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，武汉进近，雷达识别，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现襟翼卡在起飞位置，告知武汉进近该情况，并请求直飞 WHA 排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 6682，我们的襟翼卡在起飞位置，请求直飞 WHA 排故。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, roger, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，收到，右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 WHA 按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 WHA 按公布程序等待，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, you notice that 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，你注意到 1 套液压系统正在快速漏液，向武汉进近发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求下降返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 6682, 1 of the hydraulic system is leaking fuel rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 6682，1 套液压系统正在快速漏燃油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CSN 6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN 6682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the localizer Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已截获跑道 36R 航向道，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 6682, established localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 6682，已建立跑道 36R 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, cleared to land Runway 36R.
